statement.text:
Suppose that a finite group G has a normal series 1 < G1 < G2 < G such
that the groups G1 and G2 /G1 are elementary abelian p-groups, G/G2 ∼    = A5 × A5
(where A5 is the alternating group of degree 5), G1 and G2 /G1 are minimal normal
subgroups of G and G/G1 , respectively. Is it true that form(G) has finitely many
subformations?                                                     V. P. Burichenko
